title: Barekneed gillies smuggling implements of music through Trinity gates
html_source: The Seaforth Highlanders had been scheduled for 3pm at the College Sports park in connection with the bicycle races. The reference to the “implements of music” being smuggled through the gates of Trinity College is likely an off color reference to the similarity in appearance of a bagpipe to the “music-producing” male members being smuggled under the musicians' kilts.
